title: Stroke: history or residual deficits
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's past stroke and any residual deficits.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for past stroke.

HPI: Pt is a 75-year-old female presenting for routine follow-up. Hx significant for a prior ischemic stroke. Pt reports feeling well and denies any recent neurological symptoms or changes in mobility. She is stable on current regimen.

Medication List:
- Aspirin 81 mg daily
- Atorvastatin 40 mg daily
- Lisinopril 10 mg daily

Exam:
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72 (RRR), Temp 98.6, SpO2 98% on RA.
Neuro: Cranial nerves II-XII intact. Motor strength 5/5 throughout. Sensation intact. Gait steady. No residual deficits noted. Coordination and balance WNL.

Assessment:
1. Status post ischemic stroke. Pt is stable with no residual deficits.

Plan:
- Continue current medications as prescribed.
- Routine follow-up in 6 months.
- Encouraged continued exercise and healthy diet.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, DO
05/14/2026
explanations: A past ischemic stroke with no residual deficits: Z86.73, personal history (no HCC). I63 codes are for the acute stroke only.

distractors.why: I63 codes are for the acute stroke episode; after discharge use Z86.73 or I69.-.
No residual deficit is documented, so there is no sequela to code.
